fullDescription: A loud neo-brutalist / acid-yellow modal landing page anchored by a confirmation dialog: thick black borders, hard offset shadows, no rounded corners, Archivo black + Space Mono on a paper grid backdrop.
prompt:
## Resumo
A neo-brutalist / acid-yellow modal-design landing page for an overlay-generation product, anchored by a hero-stage confirmation dialog. Everything is built loud: 4-5px solid black borders, hard offset drop-shadows (no blur), zero rounded corners, a flat off-white paper backdrop with a faint engineering grid, black-and-acid color blocking, and Archivo black uppercase display type paired with Space Mono labels. Sections (sticky nav, marquee ticker, hero+modal, dark anatomy band, modal-type library gallery, stats band, pricing, acid CTA, dark footer) all sit inside a 1240px column and reflow to a single stack on mobile.

## Estilo Visual
Design in a loud neo-brutalist / acid style. Palette EXACTLY: paper background #f4f1ea, ink (borders + text) #000000, single accent acid-yellow #e8ff00, plus ash #d9d4c6 for tiny inset swatches. No gradients, no blur, no rounded corners anywhere (every corner is square). Borders are thick: 4px solid #000 default, 5px on the primary modal/featured card. Shadows are HARD offset blocks of solid color, never soft: shadow-hard = 10px 10px 0 0 #000, shadow-hard-sm = 6px 6px 0 0 #000, and a layered shadow-hard-acid = 8px 8px 0 0 #e8ff00, 8px 8px 0 4px #000. Buttons press physically: on hover translate(-2px,-2px) and grow the shadow to 8px 8px; on active translate(3px,3px) and shrink the shadow to 2px 2px (transition .08s). Backdrops use a faint engineering grid: two 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) gridlines at 40px x 40px. Fonts: Archivo for display (weights 400/600/700/800/900) used at 800-900 weight, UPPERCASE, tracking-tight, line-height ~0.92; Space Mono (400/700) for ALL labels, body copy, eyebrows, footer and meta, set uppercase with letter-spacing 0.18em-0.25em. Accent usage: acid-yellow as a highlight block behind a single hero word, as the primary-button fill, and as the lone color inside the otherwise black/paper dark bands. Tone: blunt, confident, anti-corporate. Iconify Phosphor 'bold' icons only (e.g. ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:trash-bold, ph:check-bold).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav + marquee ticker
Sticky top nav (z-50) on paper background with a 4px black bottom border, 68px tall mobile / 76px desktop, inside the 1240px column. Left: a square 36-40px black tile with acid text reading '[ ]' (a 2px black border + small hard shadow) next to 'OVERLAY' in Archivo black uppercase. Center (desktop only): four Space Mono uppercase links (System, Anatomy, Library, Pricing) at 13px, 0.12em tracking, each gets an acid background on hover. Right: a mono 'Sign in' text link and a primary acid button 'Open editor' with a 4px black border, hard-sm shadow, btn-press, and a ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon. Directly below: a full-bleed black band (acid text) with a horizontal infinite marquee in Space Mono uppercase 11-12px, 0.25em tracking, scrolling left over 22s, content duplicated for a seamless loop: 'modal design, built loud // dialogs · sheets · popovers · drawers // no rounded corners, no apologies // prompt → component in one pass //'.

### Hero (headline + the stage modal)
Full-bleed hero on the paper grid backdrop with a 4px black bottom border and two desktop-only mono corner stamps ('v.2.0 / brutalist set' top-left, 'no. 001 — dialog' top-right, 60% opacity). Inside the 1240px column, a 2-col grid: lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,560px)], gap-12/16, items-center. LEFT: an acid pill badge (4px border + hard-sm shadow, ph:lightning-fill icon + mono 'THE MODAL-DESIGN AGENT'), then a giant Archivo-black uppercase h1 'Make the / interruption / worth it.' at clamp(2.5rem,6.4vw,4.6rem), leading 0.92, with 'interruption' wrapped in an acid highlight box (box-decoration-clone). A Space Mono 14-15px paragraph (max 46ch, ink/80). Two chunky buttons: primary 'Start a modal' (black fill, paper text, 4px border, 10px hard shadow, ph:arrow-right-bold) and secondary 'See the anatomy' (paper fill, hard-sm shadow). Below, a dot-row: three 11px circles with 3px black borders (acid, ink, and a white 'paper' dot with an inset ash ring) + mono '3 states / every component'. RIGHT: THE modal as the visual hero. A paper card with a 5px black border and 10px hard shadow, faux backdrop scrim behind it (absolute -inset, bg-ink/5). Title bar (4px black bottom border): a small acid square with '!' + mono 'dialog', and a 32px square close button (3px border, hard-sm, btn-press) with '×'. Body: mono eyebrow 'CONFIRM ACTION', Archivo-black h2 'Delete the / draft?' (clamp 1.6-2.4rem), mono description, then a brutalist field labelled 'TYPE DELETE TO CONFIRM' (4px border row: ghost 'DELETE' placeholder left, black 'required' acid-text chip pinned right). Footer-of-body: two chunky buttons, acid 'Delete' (ph:trash-bold) + paper 'Cancel'. A 4px-top-border footer strip with mono 'esc to dismiss' and '⏎ confirm' (ph:keyboard-bold). A black floating spec tag overlaps the bottom-left corner (acid text, ph:ruler-bold) reading '5px border · 10px shadow'.

### Trust strip + system feature grid
Full-bleed black trust strip (paper text, 4px bottom border): a mono 'SHIPPED IN STACKS AT' label beside 5 fake brand wordmarks in Archivo-black uppercase, each with an acid Phosphor icon (ph:cube-bold Forge, ph:stack-bold Substrate, ph:diamond-bold Northbound, ph:triangle-bold Apex Labs, ph:circles-three-bold Loop&Co). Then the System section (4px bottom border): a header row with mono section index '/ 01 — the system' and an Archivo-black h2 'Overlays with a spine.' ('spine.' in an acid box), plus a mono intro paragraph aligned right on desktop. Below, a responsive 3-col card grid (sm:2 / lg:3, gap-6/7) of 6 feature cards, each a bordered paper card with hard-sm shadow holding: a 48px square acid icon tile (4px border, Phosphor bold icon), an Archivo-black uppercase h3, a Space Mono description, and a mono '→ tag' pinned to the bottom (mt-auto). One card is inverted acid-filled ('States, not screenshots') and one is black-filled with acid heading ('Infinite canvas') for rhythm.

### Anatomy dark band (annotated mini-modal)
Full-bleed black band (paper text, 4px bottom border) with a 2-col grid (lg:2, items-center). LEFT: mono index '/ 02 — anatomy' in acid, Archivo-black h2 'Four parts. / No filler.' ('No filler.' in acid), a mono paragraph (paper/75), then a numbered list of 4 items each separated by a 2px paper/20 top border: '01 Title bar', '02 Body', '03 Footer actions', '04 Backdrop', with acid mono numbers and mono descriptions. RIGHT: an annotated mini paper modal floating on the black band, using the layered acid+black shadow (shadow-hard-acid) and a 5px border. It has a title-bar row ('Save changes' + a square × close), a mono body line, and two chunky buttons (acid 'Save' + paper 'Discard'). Three small annotation tags (3px black border, acid or paper fill, mono 10px) are absolutely positioned just outside its edges labelling 'title bar' (top-right), 'body' (mid-left, translated fully left), and 'footer' (bottom-left).

### Library gallery (tabs + modal-type cards)
Section on the paper grid backdrop (4px bottom border). Header: mono '/ 03 — the library' and Archivo-black h2 'Pick an overlay. Steal the bones.' ('Steal the bones.' in acid). A horizontal tab strip of 5 chips with 4px borders, first ('Dialog') filled acid + hard-sm shadow as the active tab, the rest ('Sheet','Popover','Popover','Drawer','Toast') on paper. Then a 3-col gallery (md:3, gap-6/7) of 6 mini-modal figures, each a bordered paper card with hard-sm shadow and overflow-hidden, every card a header row (4px bottom border) with an Archivo-black uppercase label + a mono 3-digit index, and a distinct state in the body: 1) Alert 'Payment failed' (acid header) with black 'Retry' + paper 'Later' buttons; 2) Confirm 'Publish v2.0' with acid 'Publish' + paper 'Cancel'; 3) Input 'Name this frame' with a bordered field + blinking caret (animate-pulse black bar) and acid 'Save' + paper 'Esc'; 4) Loading 'Generating layers' with a 2px-bordered progress bar filled 62% acid + mono '62% · 7 of 12 layers'; 5) Success — a full acid card with a black header (acid text), ph:check-circle-bold, Archivo 'Shipped.'; 6) Empty — centered ph:stack-simple-bold (ink/40), mono 'No overlays yet.', acid 'New +' chip.

### Stats band + pricing + acid CTA + footer
STATS: full-bleed black band, a 4-up grid (grid-cols-2 / lg-4) of cells separated by 1px paper/20 gaps inside a paper/20 border, each cell an Archivo-black acid number (clamp 2.4-3.6rem) over a mono uppercase label: '12K+ overlays generated', '5 states per component', '1 prompt to ship', 'A11y focus + aria by default'. PRICING (4px bottom border): centered header, mono '/ 04 — pricing' + Archivo h2 'No tiers of nonsense.' ('nonsense.' in acid). A 3-col grid (max 980px) of cards: Free $0 (paper) and Team $80/mo (paper) flank a featured Pro $20/mo card that is acid-filled, 5px-bordered, 10px hard shadow, lifted -mt-2/-4, with a black 'MOST SHIPPED' tab. Each card has a mono tier label, an Archivo-black price, a mono sub-line, a mono check-list (ph:check-bold), and a full-width chunky bottom button (Pro's button is black-filled). CTA: full-bleed acid band (4px bottom border) with a faint grid overlay at 40% opacity, centered Archivo-black h2 'Stop shipping / sad overlays.' at clamp(2.6-5.6rem) leading 0.9, a mono paragraph, two chunky buttons (black 'Open editor' + paper 'Browse the library'), and a mono reassurance line 'no card · 20 free overlays · cancel anytime'. FOOTER: full-bleed black, a 4-col grid: brand block (acid '[ ]' tile + OVERLAY + mono blurb), 'Product' and 'Resources' mono link columns (acid headings, hover:acid links), and a 'Get the drop' newsletter input with a 2px paper/40 border row and an acid '→' submit cap. A 2px paper/20 top divider closes it with mono copyright '© 2026 Overlay — built loud' and Privacy / Terms / X links.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Hero-stage confirmation modal: paper card, 5px black border, 10px hard offset shadow, a faux backdrop scrim (bg-ink/5) behind it, a title bar with an acid '!' square + close button, a body with eyebrow/heading/description, a brutalist 'type DELETE to confirm' field (ghost placeholder + black acid-text 'required' chip), two chunky footer buttons, a 4px-top footer strip with keyboard hints, and a black overlapping spec tag in the corner.

### Componente
Hard offset shadow system (no blur): shadow-hard 10px/10px black, shadow-hard-sm 6px/6px black, and a layered shadow-hard-acid (8px acid offset + 4px black) used on the annotated anatomy modal.

### Componente
Physical press button: btn-press hover translate(-2px,-2px)+8px shadow, active translate(3px,3px)+2px shadow, 0.08s transition; used on every button and the nav CTA.

### Componente
Infinite marquee ticker: black bar, acid Space Mono uppercase text duplicated and translated -50% over 22s for a seamless horizontal scroll.

### Componente
Faint engineering grid backdrop (grid-bg): two 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) gridlines at 40px x 40px, applied to the hero, library, and (at 40% opacity) the CTA.

### Componente
Mini-modal gallery cards: six bordered figures each rendering a distinct modal state (alert / confirm / input-with-blinking-caret / loading-progress / acid success / empty), with a labelled header row and a 3-digit mono index.

### Componente
Brutalist swatch dot-row: three 11px circles with 3px black borders (acid / ink / a white 'paper' dot carrying an inset ash ring so it stays visible on the off-white page).

### Componente
Featured pricing card: acid-filled, 5px border, lifted with negative top margin, carrying a black 'MOST SHIPPED' ribbon tab.

## Notas Especiais
Everything is square: there are NO rounded corners anywhere on the page. The accent acid-yellow (#e8ff00) is the ONLY color besides black, paper, and ash, so use it sparingly and loudly (one highlighted hero word, primary buttons, the lone color in dark bands). Shadows must be solid offset blocks, never soft/blurred. Display type is Archivo at 800-900 weight, always UPPERCASE with tight tracking; every label, caption, eyebrow, and link is Space Mono uppercase with wide letter-spacing. Note the 'paper' swatch dot uses a white fill + inset 2px ash ring (#d9d4c6) so it doesn't vanish against the #f4f1ea page. Section bands are separated by 4px solid black borders and most are full-bleed while content stays inside a centered max-w-1240px column. Icons are exclusively Iconify Phosphor 'bold' weight. Built with Tailwind (CDN) using custom theme tokens paper/ink/acid/ash and font families grotesk(Archivo)/mono(Space Mono).
